title: 'Axelrod', ONI Nimitz investigator, studying Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: they have this guy, I think his name is Axelrod, he's a pseudonym and he sort of studies the phenomena, but he was the chief um Office of Naval Intelligence investigator on the Nimitz case in 2004 and he's, you know, showing up at Skinwalker Ranch and studying this stuff.

plain: Michels says a man known by the pseudonym Axelrod, who he says was the chief Office of Naval Intelligence investigator on the Nimitz case, has been turning up at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, to study what goes on there. The Office of Naval Intelligence is the Navy's intelligence service, and the Nimitz case is the 2004 encounter in which Navy pilots from the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz reported an unidentified object. Michels tells this himself, unsure even of the name ("I think his name is Axelrod"), and if true it would link the Navy's own inquiry into that encounter with the ranch.
